output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls mintToken, the balanceOf target is increased without a check, allowing the totalSupply to be arbitrarily increased, granting additional balance to the attacker.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the sender's balance is checked, if it is less than the value, an overflow occurs, granting additional balance to the attacker.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the sender's balance is checked, if it is less than the value, an overflow occurs, granting additional balance to the attacker.
